description: Largest tracked Hyperliquid wallets with public labels (and the label source), open notional, all-time PnL, largest position and its distance to liquidation. Use sort=near_liq for whales close to liquidation.

coin.description: Coin name as on Hyperliquid, e.g. BTC, ETH, kPEPE, xyz:TSLA (case-insensitive).

labelled.description: Only wallets with a public label from a cited source.

sort.description: size = open notional (default), pnl = all-time PnL, near_liq = closest to liquidation, liquidated = most liquidations.
